# InsuredBetter

> > InsuredBetter provides comprehensive insurance education and comparison resources across disability, life, business, annuities, homeowners, and auto insurance products.

InsuredBetter offers expert guidance on insurance products for individuals, families, and businesses, with detailed coverage comparisons, carrier reviews, and educational content. The platform features insights from insurance professionals including Christine Lacagnina, Cara Carlone, Jeffrey Green, and Neel Lane, with emphasis on disability insurance, retirement planning, and business coverage solutions.

## Key Topics

- Disability Insurance
- Variable Annuities
- Business Insurance
- Retirement Planning
- Life Insurance
- Homeowners Insurance
- Insurance Company Ratings
- Short-Term Disability
- Individual Coverage
- Self-Employed Insurance
- Commercial Insurance
- Income Protection
- AM Best Ratings
- Better Business Bureau (BBB)
- Employee Benefits

- [Individual Short-Term Disability Insurance](https://www.insuredbetter.com/disability-insurance/individual/short-term): Short-term disability insurance for individuals and self-employed workers

- [Qualified vs. Non-Qualified Variable Annuities](https://www.insuredbetter.com/annuities/variable-annuities/qualified-or-non-qualified): Comparison of qualified vs non-qualified variable annuity options
